items.subject: The One-Person Biotech | OpenAI Life Sciences
items.body:
What happens when scientists are no longer limited by human attention? OpenAI’s Joy Jiao and Ashoka Rajendra join a16z’s Jay Rughani and Jorge Conde to discuss how AI and thousands of parallel agents could reshape drug discovery and development.
They trace OpenAI’s life sciences work from scientific reasoning to the acquisition of Orchestra Bio, and how agents could search biological data, manage clinical trials, and navigate regulatory and manufacturing workflows.
They also discuss AI’s role in solving difficult diagnoses and a future where a single person could potentially launch and advance multiple biotech programs.

items.subject: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.body: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.subject: AWS: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS
items.body: Learn how to run two memory-bounded Kubernetes Pods on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU using open-source NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS. This walkthrough builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 image, installs KAI Scheduler and the GPU Fractioning Operator, and validates per-Pod GPU-memory contracts with enforcement and metrics.

Here are the key developments and a trend from the provided data:

**Key Developments:**

• **Clay Integrates with OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT**: Clay, a platform for sales teams, has integrated with OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT models to help users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays.
• **OpenAI's Life Sciences Initiatives**: OpenAI is exploring the use of AI in life sciences, including the acquisition of Orchestra Bio, and plans to use agents to search biological data, manage clinical trials, and navigate regulatory and manufacturing workflows.
• **Shirudo Runtime**: OpenAI and Cisco have introduced Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux that helps teams protect running systems while rolling out patches.
• **Connected Intelligence for In-House Legal**: OpenAI is exploring the use of AI to help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows, and get more from outside counsel.
• **Product Hunts: Telo and CodeDesign v3**: Two new products have been launched on Product Hunt: Telo, an Apple Health app, and CodeDesign v3, a platform for running websites and business apps from ChatGPT or Claude.

**Trend:** The trend we see here is the increasing integration of AI technologies, such as ChatGPT and Codex, in various industries and domains, including sales, life sciences, security, and enterprise software development. This trend is likely to continue as AI continues to advance and more businesses look for ways to leverage its power to improve efficiency and productivity.
